'''Jerry's Workshop''', also known as the '''Winter Island''', is an island that is open during the whole season of Late Winter (~11 hours long) every 5 days and 4 hours, or during the whole month of December. However, during the bonus events the Winter Island will only be opened 3 hours, from 1 hour before the event to 1 hour after. The island can be accessed through the [[SkyBlock Menu]], your own [[Jerry]] or the Event Stand in the [[Village]]. '''Jerry's''' is the only location where [[Winter Sea Creatures]] can be fished up.

[[Frosty]] is located near the entrance. He will reward the player with {{Item|Frosty the Snow Cannon}}, which is used in the [[Season of Jerry]] event.

== Quests ==
=== Defend Jerry's Workshop ===
{{Main|Defend Jerry's Workshop}}

Mobs will begin to spawn and attack five piles of Gifts in the village on the {{DarkAqua|23rd Late Winter}}. Players must defeat the waves of mobs that spawn to protect the [[Gift|gifts]]. These mobs cannot be damaged by regular attacks, and instead must be shot at with snowballs. Once all the [[Magma Cube|Magma Cubes]] have been killed, the event will end and the player may collect [[Gift|gifts]] from any remaining piles in the village. This event has {{Green|5}} waves lasting a total of {{Green|1}} hour.

=== Chicken Race ===
{{Main|Chicken Race}}

{{NPCSprite|Gulliver}} tasks the player with controlling a chicken by flying it through hoops in the sky. The race will end if the timer runs out, player touches the ground or leaves the chicken (e.g. dismounting the chicken by pressing Shift, using an {{Item|Aspect of the End}}, etc.) Passing through '''Cluckpoints''' will grant the player rewards for the first time they are passed and increase the timer.

The player can obtain a {{Item|Red Gift}}, {{Item|Gift Compass}}, {{Item|Frozen Chicken}}, and the {{Item|Jingle Bells}} from the '''Chicken Race'''. The {{Item|Frozen Chicken}} can be further upgraded into the {{Item|Fried Frozen Chicken}}.

=== White Gifts ===
{{Main|White Gift}}

Every time the [[Winter Island]] opens, {{Item|White Gift|amount=20}}s are scattered across '''Jerry's Workshop''', which the player is tasked with finding. Between [[SkyBlock Time|SkyBlock years]], the gifts change locations, but can generally be found in the same areas: behind lampposts, snow and on top of rooftops. If the player owns a {{Item|Gift Compass}}, they can use it to point in the direction of the nearest undiscovered [[White Gift]].

After collecting all {{Green|20}} [[White Gift|White Gifts]], the player can talk to [[St. Jerry]] to receive a [[Green Gift]].
